OpenRemote Android APK is a direct-install build for Android users while Google Play access is pending.

This build enables Android release connections to local HTTP OpenCode servers on your LAN.

Use this if you are comfortable installing APKs from GitHub. Android may show unknown-app install warnings.

Install guide: https://openremote.blairhudson.com/docs/installation
Getting started: https://openremote.blairhudson.com/docs/getting-started

For shared or public Wi-Fi, start OpenCode with password protection.
